c74object.name: tap.harmony~
c74object.description: The tap.harmony~ object is the keyboard-harmonizer effect: up to four pitch-shifted copies of a monophonic input, each holding a musical interval set in fractional semitones (interval1..interval4, ±24), summed with a dry path that is delayed inside the kernel to align with the voices — so chords land as chords, not slapback. Formant preservation (formant, on by default) keeps the singer's spectral envelope on every shifted voice, which is what separates a harmonizer from a chipmunk chorus; turning it off is the bend. Interval changes glide through the glide time constant, click-free at the 10 ms default and an audible portamento in the hundreds. The chord message sets up to four intervals and enables exactly those voices in one gesture. Each voice is a peak-locked phase vocoder with LPC formant correction from the shared DspTap library. Latency is one FFT frame (fftsize samples, dry path included). The source should be monophonic for musical results; wrap the object in an mc. operator for multichannel work.

method.name: chord
method.description: Set up to four intervals (in semitones, fractional allowed) and enable exactly those voices at level 1; voices beyond the list length are silenced. A one-message chord change.

method.name: clear
method.description: Zero all running state: the voices' analysis buffers, the dry-alignment delay, and the parameter slews.

method.name: store
method.description: Store the current parameters (intervals, levels, dry, glide, formant) in a preset slot (1..16).

method.name: recall
method.description: Morph all parameters to a stored preset (1..16). Every continuous parameter glides to the stored values over the morph time in milliseconds (default: the interp attribute); the formant flag snaps at recall start. A recalled preset holds until the DSP chain restarts, which re-applies the attribute values.

attribute.name: interval1
attribute.description: Voice 1 interval in semitones (-24..24, fractional allowed). Default 0.

attribute.name: interval2
attribute.description: Voice 2 interval in semitones (-24..24, fractional allowed). Default 0.

attribute.name: interval3
attribute.description: Voice 3 interval in semitones (-24..24, fractional allowed). Default 0.

attribute.name: interval4
attribute.description: Voice 4 interval in semitones (-24..24, fractional allowed). Default 0.

attribute.name: level1
attribute.description: Voice 1 level, linear 0..2. 0 disables the voice. Default 0.

attribute.name: level2
attribute.description: Voice 2 level, linear 0..2. 0 disables the voice. Default 0.

attribute.name: level3
attribute.description: Voice 3 level, linear 0..2. 0 disables the voice. Default 0.

attribute.name: level4
attribute.description: Voice 4 level, linear 0..2. 0 disables the voice. Default 0.

attribute.name: dry
attribute.description: Dry level, linear 0..2. The dry path is delayed inside the kernel to stay sample-aligned with the shifted voices. Default 1.

attribute.name: formant
attribute.description: LPC formant preservation on every voice. On (default) keeps the singer's envelope while the pitch moves; off shifts envelope and all.

attribute.name: glide
attribute.description: Interval glide time constant in milliseconds (0..2000). Chord changes slew click-free at the 10 ms default; hundreds of ms is an audible portamento.

attribute.name: fftsize
attribute.description: FFT frame size in samples (256..4096, rounded up to a power of two). This is the object's latency, dry path included. Applies when the DSP chain restarts. Default 1024.

attribute.name: interp
attribute.description: Default preset-morph time in milliseconds used by the recall message when no morph time is given. Default 500.

attribute.name: bypass
attribute.description: Pass the input through unprocessed (no harmonizer latency). Default 0 (off).
